I have corrected the incorrect use of D and L stereochemical descriptors used in this article.  D and L should only be used for carbohydrates and  amino acids.  I believe the original author may have been confused with d and l which refer to (+) and (-) enantiomers respectively, whereas D and L have no relationship to the sign of the optical rotation.  d and l should also not be used as they are obsolete terms and their use is strongly discouraged by IUPAC.
